messages:
Alex: Quick midday async — what I did / blockers / today
Maria: did: final pass on the routing spec doc (https://notion.redwood.ai/s/routing-spec). Blocker: need perf numbers for 8-bit variant before we lock traffic split. Today: follow-up on PR and validate fallback policy. @jin can you confirm perf run? :eyes:
Alex: PR link here for the spec + small config change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/712 — tagging for reviews, also added a couple of rollout knobs in the config.
Jin: Yup will run perf sweep this afternoon. Quick command I used for staging runs:```./scripts/run_perf.sh --model llama-2-13b --quant 8 --seq 512 --out /tmp/perf.json```I saw p50 ~75ms on a g5.2x yesterday; will post full numbers here when done.
Maria: thanks — that'll let us decide whether to set default batch_size=4 for quantized.
Sam: QA note: found a flaky behavior in the embed cache when request bursts hit >200 rps on staging. Repro steps: quick script I pasted in the bug thread. Suspect race in cache invalidation. @alex can you add the failing trace to the canary checklist?
Alex: added to canary checklist. Also pinned the test in CI to run the burst script.
Olivia: FYI ops — if perf numbers look good we can move the canary to a 5% traffic split tomorrow morning (region: us-west-2). Need final ack from product and eng by EOD so SRE can schedule.
Maria: +1 from product assuming perf + QA signoff.
Jin: Perf run finished — summarised: quant8 p50 78ms, p95 240ms, memory down ~32%. Uploaded report: https://internal.redwood/reports/perf/253111 (DM me if you need raw).
Alex: great — that settles cost side. Maria, can you update the spec with the traffic split numbers? I suggested 5% canary, fallback to non-quant variant at 500ms.
Maria: updated spec. Added explicit rollback criteria and instrumentation points: token-level latency, error-rate, top-5 prompt regressions.
Sam: QA will run the regression harness against canary tomorrow AM. I added the test matrix to the runbook. One open item: intermittent 502s when KV cache misses spike. Ticket created: #3892.
Alex: noted. Prioritization call: if 502s persist in canary we abort and rollback immediately. Otherwise proceed with 24h observation.
Olivia: ops scheduled staging -> canary deploy for 2026-03-18T09:00Z if we keep EOD signoffs. deploy-bot will post deploy start/finish.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment to canary (us-west-2) for 2026-03-18T09:00Z UTC. Changes: PR #712, runtime config tweaks, canary checks enabled.
Jin: I'll review the PR comments tonight and try to get a quick patch up for the cache race if I can reproduce. If not, will add mitigation to rollback policy.
Maria: thanks — ping me when PR is ready so I can re-verify docs.
Alex: final ask — if anyone is blocked or needs me to triage, DM me. Otherwise I'll post a short summary after EOD with the go/no-go and final checklist. :white_check_mark:
